about_the_game:
From Barcelona to the Stars

Meet Raiders Rise, a game born from the creative chaos of a scrappy, passionate team based in sunny Barcelona. While we may be a small studio, we’re backed by gaming giants Supercell and boast a collective experience of 10 to 20 years in the industry. From hits like Stumble Guys to Galaxy Life, we’ve been around the block, and we’re pouring all that knowledge into crafting a multiplayer experience like no other.

Genre-Busting Action

Raiders Rise blends the best of Bullethell and Party game genres, creating what we proudly call Full PvPE (Player vs. Player vs. Environment). Strategize, cooperate, and compete as space mercenaries, battling alien bosses, dodging traps, and racing to claim precious crystals—the ultimate energy source in a galaxy full of chaos.

Play Fair, Look Good

The game is Free to Play and monetized in a way that respects the player. Character skins  are purely for style, offering no gameplay advantages. A seasonal pass adds exclusive rewards for those who want extra flair, but fair play remains at the core of our philosophy.

Vibrant Art and Deep Lore

Step into a futuristic but barely-holding-together galaxy where civilization is a mess, crime runs wild, and the only thing keeping the universe from total collapse? Crystals. These power-packed gems are insanely valuable, dangerously unstable, and—unfortunately—guarded by some truly nasty creatures.

That’s where you come in.

You’re a Raider—part scavenger, part daredevil, part “I’ll figure it out as I go.” Alongside your rival-but-necessary teammates, you’ll dive into the wilds to hunt for crystals, dodge alien nightmares, outplay the competition, and maybe—just maybe—stab your so-called allies in the back when it benefits you. No hard feelings, right?

Meanwhile, the Great Houses—powerful factions ruling the galaxy—fund expeditions, hoard crystals, and shape the future. From corporate warlords to crystal-worshiping cultists to space-age aristocrats, these Houses have their own agendas, and if you play your cards right, they might even pay you for your troubles.

What’s Next?

Currently in development, Raiders Rise is headed for Early Access on Steam Early 2026. A mobile version is in the works post-PC launch to ensure a polished, balanced experience. Expect regular updates with fresh content like new skins, maps, and modes—because the fun doesn’t stop at launch.

Join Us

Our community lives on Discord, where you can share feedback, report bugs, or just hang out with fellow raiders. Early adopters might even score exclusive goodies—designed with your input, of course.

Ready to raid? Buckle up for a journey full of strategy, chaos, and galactic shenanigans!

🛠️ Playtests are live every Monday at 17:00 CET—and you’ll need a code to play, which we share in the Discord beforehand.

Early adopters might even score exclusive goodies—designed with your input, of course.
Ready to raid? Buckle up for a journey full of strategy, chaos, and galactic shenanigans!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bits
  • Processor: A quad-core Intel i5 4th gen or AMD FX equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 (2 GB VRAM, DX11 support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum requirements for playing at 720p@30fps
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bits
  • Processor: Intel I7-8700K or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended requirements for playing at 1080p@60fps
